resources.string: Always show the date and time, such as seen 12/03/26 at 10:00.
Telegram still controls Online, Last seen recently and Last seen this week statuses. Who can see your last seen time is configured under Privacy and security.
Choose how the last seen time of a contact is displayed.
Seen 5 minutes ago or yesterday at 14:30. Older than a day: show the date.
Calculated from advertised camera and encoder capabilities. Actual FPS is measured only after recording and may be lower.
Last recording: target %1$d FPS, camera requested up to %2$s, RAW %3$s, MP4 %4$s FPS.
%1$s camera: %2$s, range %3$s for a request up to %4$d FPS, source %5$d×%6$d, output %7$d×%7$d, H.264/AVC export.
No measurements yet: record a video message with diagnostics enabled to see the actual FPS.
Recording cameras are unavailable right now; the quality plan was not calculated.
The camera and encoder may limit resolution, frame rate and bitrate. Actual file properties may differ.
Delete all locally stored video message diagnostics reports?
No reports yet. Enable diagnostics and record a video message.
Measure frame rate before and after processing and log recording, processing and sending stages.
Off by default. Does not store videos, audio, conversations or file paths. Up to 20 reports are kept locally for 7 days and are never uploaded automatically.
The camera selects the closest supported range, so actual FPS may vary. Custom quality limits the maximum to the selected frame rate.
Record for up to 1 hour. BeyGram automatically splits the recording into 60-second video messages.
On: recording is mirrored like the preview. Off: recording looks the way others see you.
Session loading timed out. Check your connection and try again.
Telegram did not confirm the action. Refresh the list before retrying; it may already have succeeded.
60 FPS is planned, not guaranteed: only a recording shows the actual rate.
The requested rate was selected; the limit is intentional.
The camera\'s normal ranges do not reach 60 FPS. Changing the preset will not alter that; you can keep 30 or choose 24 FPS for low light.
The H.264 encoder does not confirm 60 FPS at this size. Try a lower resolution (Standard or High) or 30 FPS.
The camera stream at this size does not confirm 60 FPS. Try a lower resolution.
The camera advertises no range up to the requested maximum; the closest one was selected. Choose an available rate.
No suitable ranges are advertised; the camera default is used. Verify the result with a recording.
Frames were lost during processing, not because of a camera setting. Another recording may produce a different result.
The camera delivered less than requested. Check lighting and heat; a smaller size or 30 FPS may be more stable.
Not enough measurements to explain the frame-rate choice.
